articles.title: 5 Huge Blockbuster Movie Flops NOBODY Saw Coming (#1 Deserved Way Better)
articles.summary: The summer of 2026 has proven to be an exceptionally difficult period for the box office, marking its worst performance in years. Multiple highly anticipated blockbuster films have surprisingly flopped. A notable example is 'Supergirl,' which only managed $37.1 million domestically on its opening. This trend highlights significant challenges and evolving audience engagement within the entertainment industry.

articles.title: DC Studios Not Having Huge SDCC/Hall H Presence Makes Perfect Sense
articles.summary: DC Studios is actively generating hype for its 'Lanterns' project, planning a significant presence at San Diego Comic-Con (SDCC) in 2026. The studio intends to host a dedicated fan activation within Hall H, aiming to build early excitement and engagement among its fanbase for the upcoming venture. This strategic promotion underscores DC Studios' long-term planning for its cinematic universe.
